A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the electric Z2 strings are responsible for the string tension of the theory, and the center vortices, which are the topological defects of the theory, are responsible for the deconfinement of the theory.

electric Z2 strings and topological monopole are the main ingredients for the confinement mechanism in SU(2) gauge theory.
